node.name: VP Steer

parameters.query:
select * from hov.at_write($hov$scene$hov$, $hov${{ $('VP Prep').first().json.sceneId }}$hov$,
  $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ "Observații Scenă": $('VP Prep').first().json.steer, "Regenerează Imagine": true, "Aprobare Imagine": false }) }}$hov$::jsonb)

node.notes: Refusal ladder, attempt N: write the steer into the note slot IR Build Request appends to the image prompt, and arm the image regen flag.

node.name: VP Fire Image Regen
node.notes: The same webhook the site's Regenerate image button fires. Answers "Workflow was started"; the new still lands in ~50 s.

parameters.query: select image_media_id, regen_image, coalesce(note, '') as note from hov.scene where id = $hov${{ String($('VP Prep').first().json.sceneId || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 40) }}$hov$

node.name: VP Prompt Fix?
node.notes: Only a refusal that names a PERSON also gets the motion prompt rewritten: a real name in the direction re-triggers regardless of the still.
